HiGHS-JS 1.15.2, MIT license. Source: https://github.com/lovasoa/highs-js

Vendored from npm highs@1.15.2 for offline play. The only loader change exposes Module.FS, so structural-solver.js can read the full-precision native solution instead of the six-digit pretty-printed solution. Keep highs.js and highs.wasm at the same version.
